entries.description: Security reminders applied during Terraform code generation: always pin provider versions with version constraints, never set sensitive values as hardcoded variable defaults, mark outputs containing sensitive data with sensitive = true.
decision_rules: Pin all provider versions with constraints (e.g. version = "~> 5.0") — never omit or use "latest"
Declare sensitive variables with sensitive = true to suppress them in plan/apply logs
Default values for sensitive variables should be null or omitted — require explicit injection
anti_patterns: Using no version constraint or version = "latest" for Terraform providers
Setting default = "mysecretpassword" on a sensitive variable
Outputting sensitive values (DB passwords, private keys) without sensitive = true
